description_en: Lists the hosts that the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is authorized to perform O&M operations on through a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的主机列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-hosts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-09k22avmw0q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationHosts

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

For more information about regions and zones, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is used.
Specify a value for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机的操作系统。取值：
Linux
Windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the host. Only exact matches are supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机名称。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The address of the host. You can specify a domain name or an IP address. Only exact matches are supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en:
The source of the host. Valid values:

Local: a local host

Ecs: an ECS instance
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询主机的来源。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance. Only exact matches are supported
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the host. Valid values:

Normal: The host is running.

Release: The host is released
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机状态。取值：
Normal：正常
Release：已释放
parameters.name: source_instance_state
